items.title: Appointment of a member to the Safeguarding Board for Northern Ireland
items.summary: Health Minister, Robbie Butler, has announced the appointment of a Member to the Safeguarding Board for Northern Ireland (SBNI).

items.title: Health Minister launches NI Framework for Psychological Professions
items.summary: Health Minister Robbie Butler has launched a new framework aimed at ensuring the knowledge and expertise of the psychological professions are embedded more effectively across policy and service delivery.

items.title: Health Minister statement on Royal College of Nursing (RCN) NI vote for industrial action
items.summary: Health Minister Robbie Butler said: “I recognise the deep frustration felt by staff across Health and Social Care (HSC) and understand why nurses have voted for industrial action.

items.title: Health Minister statement on BMA industrial action
items.summary: Health Minister Robbie Butler said: “I remain committed and will do everything in my power to implement this year’s pay award as recommended by the independent Doctors’ and Dentists’ Pay Review Body (DDRB).

items.title: Dental training boost and new emergency clinic for Omagh
items.summary: Six additional dental training places have been funded across Northern Ireland and a new emergency dental clinic is to be established in Omagh, Health Minister Robbie Butler has confirmed.

items.title: Health Minister highlights the benefits of self-care for mind and body
items.summary: Health Minister Robbie Butler is encouraging the public to incorporate self-care into their daily routine.

items.title: Butler: New legislation will support safe, effective care
items.summary: Health Minister Robbie Butler has introduced the Health and Social Care (Staffing) Bill to the Northern Ireland Assembly.

items.title: Statistics on Smoking Cessation Services In Northern Ireland: 4 week follow up figures for 2025/26, and 52 week follow up figures for 2024/25
items.summary: The Department of Health today published statistical tables relating to smoking cessation services for 2025/26.

items.title: Health Minister urges public to 'Ask your Pharmacist' this winter
items.summary: ‘Ask your Pharmacist’ is the message Health Minister Robbie Butler shared at a visit to a community pharmacy in Lisburn.

items.title: Over 1,350 vasectomy procedures delivered locally by GPs
items.summary: More than 1,350 routine vasectomy procedures were carried out in GP practices across Northern Ireland last year, helping patients access treatment closer to home and reducing pressure on hospital services.

items.title: Reappointment of a Non-Executive Member to the Northern Ireland Fire & Rescue Service
items.summary: The Health Minister, Robbie Butler, has announced the reappointment of a Non-Executive (Lay) Member to the Northern Ireland Fire & Rescue Service (NIFRS).

items.title: Working together for better health: Butler launches ‘The Health Deal’
items.summary: Health Minister Robbie Butler today launched ‘The Health Deal’ – a new partnership between the public and the Health and Social Care (HSC) system, setting out how we can all work together towards a healthier future.

items.title: Butler: New GP contract will deliver better access for patients
items.summary: A newly agreed contract with GPs, bolstered by an additional investment of £40m over two years, will ultimately make it easier for patients to get appointments, Health Minister Robbie Butler has said.

items.title: £1.95m Investment in Endometriosis Services
